required_contexts_source.$comment: Re-measure rather than trusting this line; branch protection is mutable.

per_pr_job_ceiling_rationale: Measured 2026-08-21 on PR #2205: 25 runner-consuming jobs across 5 runs.
The ceiling is set just above the measured baseline so it is a RATCHET —
it fires when fan-out grows, not retroactively on today's state.
Lowering it is the goal; raising it requires a dated entry below.

budgeted_exemptions.reason: Issue/project board bookkeeping. Every job is `if:`-gated on event type and skips on ordinary PRs — measured on PR #2205: all 5 reported `skipping`.
Interactive assistant workflow, gated on an explicit mention trigger; does not fire on ordinary PR synchronize events.

dedup_exempt_workflows.reason: Uses the fixed group `pages` deliberately — GitHub Pages deployments must serialize globally, not per-branch, and must NOT cancel in progress.
